> **First load:** This page runs R in your browser via WebAssembly.
> Allow 30–60 seconds on first visit for packages to load.

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 900

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

# ── UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ui <- page_navbar(
  title = "BIOSC1203 Geomorphometric Analysis",
  theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "sandstone"),

  # ── Section 1: CSV Upload & Preview ────────────────────────────────────────
  nav_panel("1 · Upload & Preview",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        fileInput("csv_file", "Upload CSV file",
          accept = c(".csv", "text/csv"),
          buttonLabel = "Browse...",
          placeholder = "No file selected"),
        hr(),
        textInput("specimen_name", "Specimen name", value = "Genus_species",
          placeholder = "e.g. Homo_sapiens"),
        helpText("Use Genus_species format. Becomes the ID= field in TPS
                  and the key for saving metadata."),
        hr(),
        h5("Column mapping"),
        helpText("Match your CSV columns to the fields below."),
        uiOutput("col_pickers"),
        hr(),
        actionButton("run_parse", "Parse landmarks",
                     class = "btn-primary", width = "100%")
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "output.tbl_raw_ready",
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel("Raw data",                DT::DTOutput("tbl_raw")),
          tabPanel("Parsed landmarks",        DT::DTOutput("tbl_parsed")),
          tabPanel("Landmark classification", verbatimTextOutput("lm_summary"))
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  # ── Section 2: Download TPS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  nav_panel("2 · Download TPS",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        helpText("Once landmarks are parsed, generate the TPS file."),
        hr(),
        downloadButton("dl_tps", "Download TPS file", class = "btn-success")
      ),
      h5("TPS file preview"),
      verbatimTextOutput("tps_preview")
    )
  ),

  # ── Section 3: Ecological Metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────
  nav_panel("3 · Ecological Metadata",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        h5("Load saved metadata"),
        helpText("Enter your specimen name in Section 1, then click Load."),
        actionButton("load_meta", "Load from specimen name", width = "100%"),
        hr(),
        fileInput("meta_upload", "Or reload a saved metadata CSV",
          accept = c(".csv"), buttonLabel = "Browse..."),
        hr(),
        h5("Enter metadata for this specimen"),
        textAreaInput("meta_habitat", "Habitat", rows = 3,
          placeholder = "e.g. tropical rainforest understory, rocky arid scrubland..."),
        textAreaInput("meta_activity", "Activity period", rows = 2,
          placeholder = "e.g. diurnal, nocturnal, crepuscular, cathemeral..."),
        textAreaInput("meta_locomotion", "Locomotion", rows = 3,
          placeholder = "e.g. arboreal climbing, gliding, swimming, saltatorial..."),
        textAreaInput("meta_notes", "Additional notes", rows = 3,
          placeholder = "Diet, body size, observer name..."),
        hr(),
        actionButton("save_meta", "Save metadata",
                     class = "btn-success", width = "100%")
      ),
      h5("Saved metadata for all specimens"),
      helpText("Download this CSV to save your work. Re-upload it next session to reload."),
      DT::DTOutput("tbl_meta"),
      hr(),
      downloadButton("dl_meta", "Download metadata CSV",
                     class = "btn-outline-secondary")
    )
  ),

  # ── Section 4: TPS Analysis ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  nav_panel("4 · TPS Analysis",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        h5("Upload TPS file"),
        helpText("Upload a TPS file with one or more specimens
                  (LM3=n / coordinates / ID=name).
                  Combine multiple student files into one before uploading."),
        fileInput("tps_file", "Upload TPS file",
          accept = c(".tps", "text/plain"),
          buttonLabel = "Browse...",
          placeholder = "No file selected"),
        hr(),
        h5("GPA settings"),
        checkboxInput("tps_has_sliders",
                      "Include semilandmarks as sliders?", value = TRUE),
        selectInput("tps_procD", "Procrustes distance method",
          choices = c("full" = "full", "orthogonal" = "orthogonal"),
          selected = "full"),
        hr(),
        h5("PCA settings"),
        numericInput("tps_n_pcs", "Number of PCs to display",
                     value = 3, min = 2, max = 10),
        hr(),
        actionButton("run_tps_analysis", "Run GPA + PCA",
                     class = "btn-primary", width = "100%"),
        tags$div(id = "gpa-running",
          tags$div(class = "gpa-spinner"),
          "Running GPA + PCA — this may take a moment..."
        )
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "output.tbl_tps_ready",
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel("Specimens in TPS",   DT::DTOutput("tbl_tps_specimens")),
          tabPanel("GPA summary",        verbatimTextOutput("tps_gpa_summary")),
          tabPanel("PCA scores",         DT::DTOutput("tbl_tps_pca")),
          tabPanel("PCA plot",           plotly::plotlyOutput("plot_tps_pca",
                                                              height = "500px")),
          tabPanel("Variance explained", plotly::plotlyOutput("plot_tps_scree",
                                                              height = "400px")),
          tabPanel("Consensus shape",    plotOutput("plot_tps_consensus",
                                                    height = "500px"))
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

# ── Server ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Install packages in WebR on first run
  if (!requireNamespace("geomorph",  quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("geomorph")
  if (!requireNamespace("DT",        quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("DT")
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2",   quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("ggplot2")
  if (!requireNamespace("plotly",    quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("plotly")
  if (!requireNamespace("readr",     quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("readr")
  if (!requireNamespace("dplyr",     quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("dplyr")
  if (!requireNamespace("stringr",   quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("stringr")
  if (!requireNamespace("bslib",     quietly = TRUE)) webr::install("bslib")

  library(geomorph)
  library(DT)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(plotly)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)

  # ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  read_csv_flexible <- function(path) {
    tryCatch({
      df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
      if (ncol(df) < 3) df <- read_delim(path, delim = ";",
                                          show_col_types = FALSE)
      df
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }

  classify_landmarks <- function(df, label_col, x_col, y_col, z_col) {
    df |>
      select(label = all_of(label_col), x = all_of(x_col),
             y = all_of(y_col),         z = all_of(z_col)) |>
      mutate(
        label = as.character(label),
        label = if_else(is.na(label) | label == "",
                        paste0("unlabeled_", row_number()), label),
        x = as.numeric(x), y = as.numeric(y), z = as.numeric(z),
        type = case_when(
          str_detect(label, "^OC_")        ~ "semi",
          str_detect(label, "^unlabeled_") ~ "semi",
          TRUE                              ~ "fixed"
        )
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y), !is.na(z))
  }

  build_tps <- function(lm_df, specimen_name) {
    fmt <- function(v) formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 4, width = 12,
                                flag = " ")
    coord_lines <- paste(fmt(lm_df$x), fmt(lm_df$y), fmt(lm_df$z), sep = "  ")
    c(paste0("LM3=", nrow(lm_df)), coord_lines, paste0("ID=", specimen_name))
  }

  parse_tps_file <- function(path) {
    lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    specimens <- list(); spec_ids <- character(); i <- 1

    while (i <= length(lines)) {
      line <- trimws(lines[i])
      if (grepl("^LM3?=", line, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        n_lm   <- as.integer(sub("^LM3?=", "", line, ignore.case = TRUE))
        coords <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_lm, ncol = 3)
        for (j in seq_len(n_lm)) {
          i <- i + 1
          vals <- as.numeric(strsplit(trimws(lines[i]), "\\s+")[[1]])
          coords[j, ] <- vals[1:3]
        }
        spec_id <- paste0("specimen_", length(specimens) + 1)
        while (i < length(lines)) {
          i <- i + 1; next_line <- trimws(lines[i])
          if (grepl("^ID=", next_line, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
            spec_id <- sub("^ID=", "", next_line, ignore.case = TRUE); break
          }
          if (grepl("^LM3?=", next_line, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
            i <- i - 1; break
          }
        }
        specimens[[length(specimens) + 1]] <- coords
        spec_ids <- c(spec_ids, spec_id)
      } else { i <- i + 1 }
    }
    if (length(specimens) == 0) return(NULL)
    p <- nrow(specimens[[1]]); n <- length(specimens)
    A <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(p, 3, n))
    for (k in seq_len(n)) A[, , k] <- specimens[[k]]
    dimnames(A)[[3]] <- spec_ids
    list(A = A, ids = spec_ids, n_lm = p, n_spec = n)
  }

  # ── section 1 & 2 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  raw_data <- reactive({
    req(input$csv_file)
    read_csv_flexible(input$csv_file$datapath)
  })

  output$col_pickers <- renderUI({
    df <- raw_data(); req(df); cols <- names(df)
    guess <- function(p) {
      m <- cols[str_detect(tolower(cols), paste(tolower(p), collapse = "|"))]
      if (length(m)) m[1] else cols[1]
    }
    tagList(
      selectInput("col_label", "Label column", choices = cols,
                  selected = guess(c("label","name","id","lm"))),
      selectInput("col_x", "X / R coord", choices = cols,
                  selected = guess(c("^r$","_x$","x$","r$"))),
      selectInput("col_y", "Y / A coord", choices = cols,
                  selected = guess(c("^a$","_y$","y$","a$"))),
      selectInput("col_z", "Z / S coord", choices = cols,
                  selected = guess(c("^s$","_z$","z$","s$")))
    )
  })

  output$tbl_raw <- DT::renderDT({
    req(raw_data())
    DT::datatable(raw_data(),
                  options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10),
                  rownames = FALSE)
  })

  output$tbl_raw_ready <- reactive({ !is.null(raw_data()) })
  outputOptions(output, "tbl_raw_ready", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

  parsed <- eventReactive(input$run_parse, {
    req(raw_data(), input$col_label, input$col_x, input$col_y, input$col_z)
    classify_landmarks(raw_data(), input$col_label,
                       input$col_x, input$col_y, input$col_z)
  })

  output$tbl_parsed <- DT::renderDT({
    req(parsed())
    DT::datatable(
      parsed() |> mutate(across(c(x, y, z), \(v) round(v, 4))),
      options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 15), rownames = FALSE
    ) |>
      DT::formatStyle("type", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        c("fixed", "semi"), c("#d4edda", "#cce5ff")))
  })

  output$lm_summary <- renderPrint({
    req(parsed()); df <- parsed()
    cat("Total landmarks:", nrow(df), "\n")
    cat("Fixed landmarks:", sum(df$type == "fixed"), "\n")
    cat("Semilandmarks  :", sum(df$type == "semi"),  "\n\n")
    cat("Fixed landmark labels:\n")
    cat(paste(" ", df$label[df$type == "fixed"], collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
    cat("Semilandmark labels:\n")
    cat(paste(" ", df$label[df$type == "semi"],  collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  })

  tps_lines <- reactive({
    req(parsed())
    build_tps(parsed(), input$specimen_name)
  })

  output$tps_preview <- renderText({
    req(tps_lines())
    paste(tps_lines(), collapse = "\n")
  })

  output$dl_tps <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0(input$specimen_name, ".tps"),
    content  = function(file) writeLines(tps_lines(), file)
  )

  # ── section 3: metadata ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  meta_table <- reactiveVal(tibble(
    specimen = character(), habitat = character(), activity = character(),
    locomotion = character(), notes = character(), saved_at = character()
  ))

  upsert_meta <- function(tbl, specimen, habitat, activity, locomotion, notes) {
    bind_rows(
      tbl |> filter(specimen != !!specimen),
      tibble(specimen = specimen, habitat = habitat, activity = activity,
             locomotion = locomotion, notes = notes,
             saved_at = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
    )
  }

  observeEvent(input$load_meta, {
    req(input$specimen_name)
    row <- meta_table() |> filter(specimen == input$specimen_name)
    if (nrow(row) == 1) {
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "meta_habitat",    value = row$habitat)
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "meta_activity",   value = row$activity)
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "meta_locomotion", value = row$locomotion)
      updateTextAreaInput(session, "meta_notes",      value = row$notes)
    } else {
      showNotification(paste0("No saved metadata for '",
                               input$specimen_name, "'."),
                       type = "warning", duration = 4)
    }
  })

  observeEvent(input$meta_upload, {
    df <- tryCatch(read_csv(input$meta_upload$datapath,
                            show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(df)) {
      meta_table(df)
      showNotification("Metadata reloaded.", type = "message", duration = 3)
    }
  })

  observeEvent(input$save_meta, {
    req(input$specimen_name)
    meta_table(upsert_meta(meta_table(), input$specimen_name,
                           input$meta_habitat, input$meta_activity,
                           input$meta_locomotion, input$meta_notes))
    showNotification(
      paste0("Saved '", input$specimen_name,
             "'. Download CSV to keep between sessions."),
      type = "message", duration = 4)
  })

  output$tbl_meta <- DT::renderDT({
    tbl <- meta_table()
    validate(need(nrow(tbl) > 0, "No metadata saved yet."))
    DT::datatable(tbl, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10),
                  rownames = FALSE)
  })

  output$dl_meta <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0("metadata_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
    content  = function(file) write_csv(meta_table(), file)
  )

  # ── section 4: TPS analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  tps_parsed <- eventReactive(input$tps_file, {
    req(input$tps_file)
    result <- tryCatch(parse_tps_file(input$tps_file$datapath),
                       error = function(e) NULL)
    validate(need(!is.null(result),
      "Could not parse TPS file. Check format: LM3=n / coords / ID=name."))
    result
  })

  output$tbl_tps_specimens <- DT::renderDT({
    req(tps_parsed()); tp <- tps_parsed()
    DT::datatable(
      data.frame(Index = seq_along(tp$ids), Specimen = tp$ids,
                 N_landmarks = tp$n_lm),
      options = list(pageLength = 20), rownames = FALSE)
  })

  output$tbl_tps_ready <- reactive({ !is.null(input$tps_file) })
  outputOptions(output, "tbl_tps_ready", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

  tps_results <- eventReactive(input$run_tps_analysis, {
    req(tps_parsed()); tp <- tps_parsed()
    validate(need(tp$n_spec >= 2,
      paste0("GPA requires at least 2 specimens. Your file has ", tp$n_spec,
             ". Combine more student TPS files and re-upload.")))

    gpa <- tryCatch(
      gpagen(tp$A, curves = NULL,
             ProcD = (input$tps_procD == "full"), print.progress = FALSE),
      error = function(e) validate(need(FALSE, paste("GPA failed:", e$message)))
    )
    pca <- tryCatch(
      gm.prcomp(gpa$coords),
      error = function(e) validate(need(FALSE, paste("PCA failed:", e$message)))
    )
    list(gpa = gpa, pca = pca, ids = tp$ids)
  })

  output$tps_gpa_summary <- renderPrint({
    validate(need(input$run_tps_analysis > 0,
                  "Click 'Run GPA + PCA' to see results."))
    req(tps_results()); res <- tps_results()
    cat("=== GPA (Generalized Procrustes Analysis) ===\n\n")
    print(summary(res$gpa))
    cat("\nConsensus shape (first 6 landmarks):\n")
    print(round(head(res$gpa$consensus, 6), 4))
  })

  output$tbl_tps_pca <- DT::renderDT({
    validate(need(input$run_tps_analysis > 0,
                  "Click 'Run GPA + PCA' to see results."))
    req(tps_results())
    pca <- tps_results()$pca
    eigs <- pca$sdev^2; var_exp <- round(eigs / sum(eigs) * 100, 2)
    n_pcs <- min(input$tps_n_pcs, length(var_exp))
    scores_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:n_pcs, drop = FALSE])
    names(scores_df) <- paste0("PC", 1:n_pcs, " (", var_exp[1:n_pcs], "%)")
    scores_df$Specimen <- rownames(scores_df)
    scores_df <- scores_df[, c("Specimen", setdiff(names(scores_df),"Specimen"))]
    DT::datatable(scores_df, options = list(scrollX = TRUE), rownames = FALSE)
  })

  output$plot_tps_pca <- plotly::renderPlotly({
    validate(need(input$run_tps_analysis > 0,
                  "Click 'Run GPA + PCA' to see results."))
    req(tps_results())
    pca <- tps_results()$pca
    eigs <- pca$sdev^2; var_exp <- round(eigs / sum(eigs) * 100, 2)
    scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x); scores$Specimen <- rownames(scores)
    p <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2, label = Specimen)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#2c7bb6") +
      geom_text(vjust = -0.8, size = 3) +
      labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", var_exp[1], "% variance)"),
           y = paste0("PC2 (", var_exp[2], "% variance)"),
           title = "PCA morphospace — PC1 vs PC2") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
    plotly::ggplotly(p, tooltip = c("label", "x", "y"))
  })

  output$plot_tps_scree <- plotly::renderPlotly({
    validate(need(input$run_tps_analysis > 0,
                  "Click 'Run GPA + PCA' to see results."))
    req(tps_results())
    pca <- tps_results()$pca
    eigs <- pca$sdev^2; var_exp <- round(eigs / sum(eigs) * 100, 2)
    n_show <- min(input$tps_n_pcs, length(var_exp))
    df_sc <- data.frame(
      PC       = factor(paste0("PC", 1:n_show), levels = paste0("PC", 1:n_show)),
      Variance = var_exp[1:n_show]
    )
    p <- ggplot(df_sc, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_line(aes(group = 1), colour = "#d7191c", linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(colour = "#d7191c", size = 2) +
      labs(title = "Scree plot", y = "% Variance", x = "") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
    plotly::ggplotly(p)
  })

  output$plot_tps_consensus <- renderPlot({
    validate(need(input$run_tps_analysis > 0,
                  "Click 'Run GPA + PCA' to see results."))
    req(tps_results())
    cons <- tps_results()$gpa$consensus
    df_plot <- data.frame(x = cons[,1], y = cons[,2], z = cons[,3],
                          label = rownames(cons))
    par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))
    plot(df_plot$x, df_plot$y, pch = 19, col = "#2c7bb6", cex = 1.2,
         xlab = "X (R)", ylab = "Y (A)", main = "Consensus — R-A view")
    text(df_plot$x, df_plot$y, labels = df_plot$label, cex = 0.6, pos = 3)
    plot(df_plot$x, df_plot$z, pch = 19, col = "#2c7bb6", cex = 1.2,
         xlab = "X (R)", ylab = "Z (S)", main = "Consensus — R-S view")
    text(df_plot$x, df_plot$z, labels = df_plot$label, cex = 0.6, pos = 3)
  })

  # Spinner JS
  session$onFlushed(function() {
    shinyjs::runjs("
      $(document).on('click', '#run_tps_analysis', function() {
        $('#gpa-running').css('display', 'flex');
      });
      $(document).on('shiny:idle', function() {
        $('#gpa-running').css('display', 'none');
      });
    ")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
